format.pcm: variable-count timestamped chunks with exact source intervals
format.packets: separate timestamped sequence blocks with explicit single-erasure FEC

invariants: PCM push/pull and packet FEC/PLC are separate objects; recovery never writes PCM and PCM concealment never fabricates packets.
Input chunks must be contiguous in the declared source coordinate; a gap is rejected, never filled.
Ratio is a positive exact rational; updates affect only later chunks and never remap already admitted chunks.
Output-to-source mapping is piecewise monotonic per stream and independent across streams.
Availability is bounded by admitted input; backpressure rejects new input with zero consumed count instead of dropping older input.
Flush is finite: no output is created beyond the admitted mapping, and EOS follows after the bounded tail is pulled.
Packet recovery preserves the original sequence and timestamp; more erasures than the declared parity can repair are explicit failures, not guesses.
Public v0 ABI, descriptors, provider registry, engine defaults and buffer capacities are unchanged.
